title: Stock movement

type_hints.in: Add received stock to a warehouse (purchase, return).
type_hints.out: Remove stock from a warehouse (damage, internal use).
type_hints.transfer: Move stock from one warehouse to another.
type_hints.adjust: Correct the count after a stock take: the warehouse quantity becomes the number you enter.

variation_required: Select which variation this movement is for
adjust_hint: The current stock in this warehouse will be replaced by this number.
same_warehouse: The source and destination warehouses must be different.
